mentions.name: Daigest
mentions.description: An AI-powered industry monitoring service that lets users pick keywords and sources (news sites, blogs, YouTube, communities) and sends scheduled summary digests. Unlike Google Alerts, it reads the content and delivers a digest instead of a list of links, replacing 30+ minutes of daily manual site-checking with a 3-minute read.
mentions.problem: The builder was spending 30+ minutes per day manually checking the same sites for industry news.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Daigest (https://daige.st) — it monitors your industry using AI.
